workflow: London is a leading global city, renowned for its vibrant cultural, economic and educational scenes. It is also one of the most populous cities in the world, with a population of 8.9 million in 2019. It is a hub for many industries, including arts, commerce, entertainment, fashion, finance, healthcare, media, professional services, tourism, and transport.
